Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over this surface reads no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: the risk is produced by objectui's own record forms: `ModalForm` (and `DrawerForm`) pass a refused write only to a host `onError`, and the console's global dialog gives none, so the refusal vanishes and the dialog stays open. The platform path that covers it: none for this dialog; the record page's own saves and the action-param dialog already show refusals. Who reaches it: every user whose create or edit through the global dialog is refused (measured: Setup → Approvals → Delegations → New, 403 `FORBIDDEN`), and every react page opening `<ObjectForm formType="modal"|"drawer">` without `onError`.
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: open objectui PRs touching `ModalForm.tsx` or `AppContent.tsx`: none (the eleven open PRs' file lists were read at this claim). `DrawerForm.tsx` is held by this seat's own PR objectstack-ai/objectui#13235 (objectui#13219, in the merge queue; two lines on `SheetContent`, not the submit `catch`); the dev syncs with `git merge origin/main` once it lands. `ModalForm.tsx` last took `9eb1479` (objectui#13130).

Why `Clause-②: no`: a form shows a refusal it already receives. No export, prop, schema key or accept set of a published package moves.

Claimed at: 2026-10-20T11:12Z
